subject: Geopolitics
title: OPEC Plus and Russia
description: A micro-lesson that makes OPEC Plus and Russia usable.

hook.text: In 2016, Russia joined OPEC's production cuts without joining the group.

buildup.text: OPEC+ coordinates production among 23 nations. More producers cutting means higher prices and more market control.

discovery.text: Russia gains OPEC's price discipline. Saudi Arabia gains Russia's volume.

twist.text: The alliance is fragile. In 2020, Saudi and Russia fought a price war that crashed oil to negative $37 per barrel.

climax.text: OPEC+ wields enormous market power but internal rivalry can shatter it overnight. Alliances of convenience break easily.

quiz.question: What happened when Saudi Arabia and Russia clashed in 2020?
options: Oil prices crashed to negative territory
